message.content: Which of our stateful object classes have instances that currently hold stored data?

content.text: The objects list returns `hasStoredData` per instance, so I'll request it for a placeholder namespace.

I can't tell you which classes have stored data yet, because these tools only build the requests and don't send them.

I built two requests:
- `GET /accounts/demo/workers/durable_objects/namespaces` lists your Durable Object namespaces. Each namespace is one class and carries its `class` and `script` names.
- `GET /accounts/demo/workers/durable_objects/namespaces/{id}/objects` lists the instances in one namespace. Each instance carries a `hasStoredData` flag. I built it for a placeholder namespace, `demo-namespace`.

To get the answer, run the objects request once for each namespace ID the first request returns, following `cursor` when there are more results. A class has instances holding stored data if any instance comes back with `hasStoredData: true`.

I read the durable-objects skill, then built the namespace-list request and an object-list request for `demo-namespace`. Running the object list for every namespace the first call returns will show which classes have instances with stored data.
